# stalwart_mta_outbound_strategy (Data Source)

Configures outbound message delivery routing, scheduling, and TLS strategies. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `connection_strategy` (Attributes) An expression that returns the connection strategy to use when delivering messages to remote SMTP servers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_strategy))
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `route` (Attributes) An expression that returns the route name to use when delivering queued messages (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--route))
- `schedule` (Attributes) An expression that returns the scheduling strategy to use when queueing messages (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `tls` (Attributes) An expression that returns the TLS strategy to use when delivering messages to remote SMTP servers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tls))
